outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic (breast anatomy diagram) plus a table summarizing breast cancer subtype classification and frequencies; it is not a plot requiring individual data points.
Panel B is a schematic illustrating the study aim (circadian phenotypes and their relationship to drug sensitivity/tumor growth); no quantitative plot is shown.
Panel C is a schematic depicting the luciferase reporter measurement method; no data plot is present.
Panel D shows illustrative line traces of circadian signals (Model #1-3) used to depict stationary/non-stationary analysis concepts. Line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel E is a correlation heatmap of circadian parameters; heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel F shows an illustrative line plot of cell number growth over time for representative models; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel G shows illustrative dose-response line curves (growth inhibition vs. dose); line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel H shows a gene expression heatmap and a binary mutation matrix; heatmaps/tables are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel I contains PCA and 3D scatter plots where each dot already represents an individual sample/cell line, satisfying the requirement for individual data points.
